svg.title: Anthropic opens a standard to let AI agents run lab robots; in the demo, Claude's fix for a bubble was more bubbles
svg.desc: A robotic pipette arm, wired to an agent's read/write driver chip, dispensing into a multi-well plate while bubbles foam up out of the one highlighted well. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Anthropic opens a standard to let AI agents run lab robots; in the demo, Claude's fix for a bubble was more bubbles”. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 343948017.
